title: Widget fonts schema migration and 8-round catalog expansion
content:
This update expands the JeffersonWM widget typeface catalog to 213 curated Google Fonts across 8 distinct selection rounds and introduces a structured schema to organize and query font batches cleanly.

Key highlights:

  • Rounds schema and catalog migration: Added an indexed round column to widget_fonts, backfilled existing font selections across Rounds 01–06, and ingested Rounds 07 and 08 while preserving earliest round origin for duplicates.
  • Interactive CLI and NPM font exploration: Added a dedicated font listing utility with instant sorting (alphabetical, probability, round) and scoped filtering (e.g., npm run fonts:r7, npm run fonts:r8).
  • Multi-site typeface sharing readiness: Verified cross-origin API and shared database patterns so future apps (like Billionaire) can consume shared and distinct subsets from the central typography catalog.
